# CWI Masters

> The verified machine-readable catalog of Cumulative Web Inc — 52 tracks with sourced ISRCs, credits, and sync flags. Generated 2026-09-20.
> Evidence tiers: silver = identifiers verified from distributor dashboard; bronze = public-source identifiers, not distributor-confirmed.
> Conflicts are published as conflicts (value null, candidates documented). Unknowns are published as unknown. Nothing is guessed.

## Use
- Full catalog: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/masters/v1/catalog.json
- Manifest: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/masters/v1/manifest.json
- One track: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/masters/v1/tracks/{track_id}.json
- Sync availability: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/masters/v1/sync/availability.json
- Sync inquiry schema: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/masters/v1/sync/inquiry-schema.json
